_comment: REDIRECT TARGETS THAT DO NOT YET RESOLVE.
The 301 map in content/url-map.md proposed these routes during Phase 0,
before the slugs and the information architecture settled. Every one is a
legacy URL that WILL 404 after the domain move unless it is closed, so the
list is tracked here rather than left as a silent 404.
tests/redirects.spec.ts asserts the dead set is EXACTLY this set — so an
existing gap cannot be forgotten and a NEW gap cannot appear unnoticed.
Closing one means deleting its line here and watching the test go green.
This file is the pre-DNS gate referenced by LAUNCH.md.

gaps.why: D1a moved Thalasses Rituals out of the villa collection and made it the Weddings venue; the map still names the old route.
